scheme_name: Dr. Ambedakar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for the Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
other_conditions: Must be an Indian national belonging to the General Category (not SC, ST, or OBC).
Must be permanently settled in a State/UT of India and studying a recognized post‑matriculation or post‑secondary course in a government institution.
For employed students, combined annual income of the student and parents/guardians must not exceed ₹1,00,000; same limit applies to unemployed students based on parents’ income.
Only up to two boys from the same parents/guardians can receive scholarships (no restriction for girls).
Recipients cannot hold any other scholarship or stipend simultaneously.

Correspondence course students are eligible for reimbursement of non‑refundable fees and an annual book allowance of Rs. 900; students receiving coaching assistance are ineligible for coaching stipends; certain rules on course changes and subsequent failures apply.
benefits_summary: Provides a maintenance allowance, reimbursement of non‑refundable fees, and additional allowances for books, readers, study tours, and thesis printing for eligible post‑matriculation EBC students.
